headline: Sensex surges nearly 1,000 points as Nifty reclaims 25,500 led by auto and bank stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Banking and auto stocks drove a major market rally, pushing Bank Nifty to a record high.
Sensex surged nearly 1,000 points to reclaim the 83,000 level.
Nifty topped 25,500 for the first time since February.
Strong buying momentum overcame earlier cautious sentiment driven by Fed rate hike concerns.
whatHappening: Indian markets bounced back strongly despite starting lower over US Fed rate hike worries.
Airtel overtook HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand according to a new report.
Tata Trusts scheduled a board meeting for November 20, with Tata Sons listing not on the agenda.
Maharashtra announced new rules mandating double wages and compensatory leave for employees working on weekly off days.
summary: Indian markets surged significantly as auto and banking stocks led a strong rally, lifting Nifty past 25,500 and Sensex up nearly 1,000 points. In major brand news, Airtel surpassed HDFC Bank to become India's most valuable brand. Key stocks in focus today include Coal India, Paytm, NLC India, Voltas, and JK Cement.
